pictures.c: Subsurface geological section from oil industry data, showing gently sloping and undisturbed deposits of the Alpine monocline. The Mantova ridge is perpendicular to the section and crosses it near the Rodigo 1 well (from Cassano et al. [1986]).

pictures.t: Surface elevation changes from geodetic line
pictures.c: Elevation changes from repeated leveling surveys (1953-1985); the diagram shows relative uplift of the sector south of Mantova, in agreement with the geomorphic signal supplied by the diversion of the Mincio River (from De Martini et al. [1998]).

pictures.t: Geomorphological scheme of the Mantova area
pictures.c: Geomorphological scheme of the Mantova area showing a sharp diversion of Mincio River resulting from uplift of an E-W ridge. Paleobeds of Mincio R. are shown as "M" (from Castaldini and Panizza [1988]).

Detailed topographic contour map showing paleo-channels of the Mincio R. and the topographic expression of the anticline south of the diversion. Contour interval is 1 m up to 30 m a.s.l., 2 m thereafter (from De Martini et al. [1998]).
